note: Every priced offer across providers (latest snapshot: DynamoDB ms-router-catalog or SQLite locally). One entry per provider + region + instanceType + capacityType. pricePerHourUsd is the provider's price for the whole instance; pricePerGpuHourUsd divides by gpuCount; pricePerHourUsdc is what Moonshift charges (external capacity x (1 + margin), Moonshift GPUs at their listed price). priceSource: live (called the API), static (hand table with asOf) or fixture (mock mode or no credentials). availability.status: live (provider reports capacity, count), likely (placement score >= 5 or on-demand), unknown, none. executable is true only for offers in the fleet (an account plus a worker endpoint).
